# Hover

> > Hover provides 3D modeling and estimation technology for contractors, homeowners, and insurance companies to visualize, measure, and manage exterior renovation projects.

Hover transforms smartphone photos into accurate 3D property models with automated measurements and material estimates. The platform serves roofing contractors, home improvement professionals, insurance adjusters, and homeowners, with integrations into Verisk's Xactimate and partnerships with major insurers including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide.

## Key Topics

- 3D modeling and visualization
- Property measurement and estimation
- Exterior renovation design
- Roofing and siding projects
- Insurance claims processing
- Storm damage assessment
- Xactimate integration
- Contractor sales tools
- Material takeoffs and waste reduction
- Paint color visualization
- Home improvement technology
- Digital blueprints and plans
- ROI for contractors
- Customer visualization tools

- [Exterior Home 3D Design for Construction and Renovations](https://hover.to/design/exterior): Hover's photo-to-3D exterior design app for renovation visualization
- [Calculate your ROI with Hover](https://hover.to/roi-calculator/v1): Interactive ROI calculator for contractors to assess Hover's business impact
- [Paint Visualizer | Home Exterior and Interior Design](https://hover.to/paint-color-visualizer): Virtual paint visualizer tool for trying colors on home photos
- [Hover: The Easy-to-Use Home Construction Estimation App](https://hover.to/blog/the-easy-to-use-home-construction-estimation-app): Overview of Hover's 3D modeling & estimation app for contractors
